verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.vast.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured index linking to .md pages), and the documentation is served as markdown (.md URLs throughout). Vast.ai also publishes a dedicated agents guide with an installable `vastai` agent skill for AI coding assistants, plus a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: no independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).
